name: agent
description: Python 3.12 with numpy, pandas, scipy, scikit-learn and friends preloaded -- an agent code executor

files.text:
import time

t = time.perf_counter()
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import sklearn
took = time.perf_counter() - t

df = pd.DataFrame({"x": np.arange(6), "y": np.arange(6) ** 2})
print(f"Hello from hello!")
print(f"numpy {np.__version__}, pandas {pd.__version__}, scikit-learn {sklearn.__version__} "
      f"imported in {took * 1000:.1f} ms (already loaded in the warm snapshot)")
print(df.describe().loc[["mean", "std", "max"]])

[rootfs]
image = "ghcr.io/hyperlight-dev/hyperlight-unikraft/agent:initrd-vX.Y.Z"

[run]

warm = true

# BusyBox runs in NOMMU mode here (the kernel has vfork, not fork): every
# applet is its own process, and a pipe or a $(...) substitution between
# processes is not supported yet -- so one command per line, and shell
# builtins (echo, printf, read, test, arithmetic) wherever possible.
echo "Hello from hello!"
printf 'Running on '
uname -srm
echo "inside a Hyperlight micro-VM"

name: bash-repl
description: An interactive shell on BusyBox (hush): type commands, the guest runs them

files.text:
# The whole guest session: read a line, run it, print a prompt, until stdin
# closes. `eval` runs each line in this shell, so `cd` and variables persist
# from one command to the next.
echo "hello: a shell inside a Hyperlight micro-VM. Ctrl-D to leave."
while true; do
    printf '%s' "${PS1:-# }"
    if ! IFS= read -r cmd; then
        # End of input.  A last line with no newline has still filled cmd:
        # run it, and stop here rather than read past the end.
        [ -n "$cmd" ] && eval "$cmd"
        break
    fi
    eval "$cmd"
done
echo

manifest_version = 1

[app]
name = "hello"

[rootfs]
image = "ghcr.io/hyperlight-dev/hyperlight-unikraft/bash:initrd-vX.Y.Z"

[run]
script = "repl.sh"
warm = true

name: http-dotnet
description: An ASP.NET Core (Kestrel) HTTP server, published in Docker onto the dotnet-aot rootfs

files.text:
# The guest rootfs for hello: the app, published self-contained and
# trimmed for linux-musl by the .NET SDK, on the published dotnet-aot base
# (exec driver, musl linker, glibc compat symlinks). `hluk build` builds it
# for the host's CPU and exports it as .hluk/rootfs.cpio; `hluk run` boots it.
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY Program.cs App.csproj ./
RUN dotnet publish -c Release --os linux-musl --self-contained \
    -p:PublishTrimmed=true \
    -p:InvariantGlobalization=true \
    -o /out

FROM ghcr.io/hyperlight-dev/hyperlight-unikraft/dotnet-aot:vX.Y.Z
COPY --from=build /out/ /app/
# The C++ runtime the CoreCLR host needs.
COPY --from=build /usr/lib/libstdc++.so.6 /usr/lib/libstdc++.so.6
COPY --from=build /usr/lib/libgcc_s.so.1 /usr/lib/libgcc_s.so.1

manifest_version = 1

[app]
name = "hello"

[rootfs]
dockerfile = "Dockerfile"

[run]
exec = "/app/App"
warm = true

[run.net]
all = true
ports = [8080]

name: http-node
description: An Express HTTP server on a rootfs you extend with npm packages (Dockerfile)

files.text:
# The guest rootfs for hello: the published node base plus the packages
# package.json names. `hluk build` builds it and exports it as
# .hluk/rootfs.cpio; `hluk run` boots it.
#
# The guest runs the script with cwd = /, so require() resolves from
# /node_modules (Node's search walks up from the module's directory).
FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /nm
COPY package.json .
RUN npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund

FROM ghcr.io/hyperlight-dev/hyperlight-unikraft/node:vX.Y.Z
COPY --from=deps /nm/node_modules /node_modules

manifest_version = 1

warm = true
warm_exec = "require('express')"

[run.net]
all = true
ports = [8080]

name: http-python
description: A Flask HTTP server on a rootfs you extend with pip packages (Dockerfile)

files.text:
# The guest rootfs for hello: the published python-shell base plus the
# packages in requirements.txt. `hluk build` builds it and exports it as
# .hluk/rootfs.cpio; `hluk run` boots it.
FROM ghcr.io/hyperlight-dev/hyperlight-unikraft/python-shell:vX.Y.Z AS base

# pip runs in a real Linux stage, then the packages are copied into the
# rootfs, which is FROM scratch and has no shell to run pip in.
FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm AS installer
COPY --from=base / /rootfs/
COPY requirements.txt /tmp/requirements.txt
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r /tmp/requirements.txt \
        --target /rootfs/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages

FROM scratch
COPY --from=installer /rootfs/ /
flask

manifest_version = 1

[app]
name = "hello"

[rootfs]
dockerfile = "Dockerfile"

[run]
script = "server.py"
warm = true
warm_exec = "import flask"

[run.net]
all = true
ports = [8080]

name: python-shell
description: A Python 3.12 script with a BusyBox shell to run commands through subprocess

files.text:
import subprocess
import sys

print(f"Hello from hello!")
print(f"Python {sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}, inside a Hyperlight micro-VM")

# /bin/sh is BusyBox's hush. It runs in NOMMU mode here (vfork, not fork),
# so give it one command at a time: no pipes or $(...) between processes.
for cmd in ["uname -srm", "which python3 sh"]:
    result = subprocess.run(["/bin/sh", "-c", cmd], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(f"$ {cmd}")
    print(result.stdout, end="")
